audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Level 1 to Ryze and 2+ items to Ryze, while the prose says Level 1 is yours and you reclaim the game at two items; it also gave First item to neither side though the whys say it tips to Ryze.
audit.why: The mirror audit (ryze vs urgot) set the chart to Urgot, Urgot, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Skill; whys[] here already read the same way, and the 59.91% win rate over 641 games supports an Urgot-favoured lane.
audit.corrected: Urgot Levels 1-2, skill through Level 6, Ryze at first item, back to skill with two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 line asserts a 25% HP execute threshold and ignores Realm Warp's cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's Fear Beyond Death text states a health threshold with no number, so 25% is unverified; Realm Warp is 180/160/140s and is not an escape in a 1v1.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is your spike: below Fear Beyond Death's threshold he dies, and his only ult is a 180s portal that does not save him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison is described as a flat point-blank root; the page never states the Flux condition.
audit.why: Riot's W text: it damages and slows, and roots only if the target already has Flux (E) on them. Dodging Spell Flux downgrades his entire lockdown to a slow. W is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s at 615 range.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison roots only after Spell Flux lands — sidestep the E and the cage is just a slow; the W is 11s at rank 1, which is your commit window.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Rune Prison: 11s at rank 1, and it only roots if Spell Flux hit you first — dodge the E and the cage is a slow you walk out of.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It roots only after Spell Flux lands; without the E it is a slow you can walk through.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Ryze is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death online — under its threshold Ryze is dead, and Realm Warp is 180s and no escape. Trade him to half first.

edits.before: Late game your R is a pick machine: any frontliner dropped under 25% dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Ryze carry threat: 8/10 — end the game before he cashes it.
edits.after: Late game your R is a pick machine: anyone dropped under its threshold dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Ryze carry threat: 8/10 — end before he cashes it.

notes: The '25% HP' execute number is inherited across this champion's pages and is not in Riot's Fear Beyond Death text; removed where edited, still present in report[11].t on other matchups. Urgot's Q carries a 'dash' kit flag that contradicts Riot's description (explosive charge at a location) — Disdain (E) is the real charge, so nothing was written from that flag.
